findings.title: r1 W2 fix consumes the leads but the HUD legend now promises reaction windows the sim does not enforce
findings.evidence: app/main.odin:552-553: `lead_s := fmt.tprintf("node strain ~%ds to critical · node critical ~%ds · pipe ~%ds to saturation — ring + glyph, never color alone", wb.node_strained_lead_ticks / u64(hz), wb.node_critical_lead_ticks / u64(hz), wb.pipe_pressure_lead_ticks / u64(hz))` with balance.json 600/200/400 @ logic_hz 20 → "node strain ~30s to critical · node critical ~10s · pipe ~20s to saturation". core/warnings.odin strain_level: `if pct >= i64(red) do return .Red; if pct >= i64(amber) do return .Amber` — pure percent mapping, no time component. demos/warn.dem:6-7: "host Node_Strained @1 (2 waiting = 75% of the 80 u/s host throughput), host Node_Critical @2 (4 waiting = 150%)".
findings.detail: The caption claims a ~30 s strained→critical window; the golden demo itself goes strained→critical in ONE tick. The leads remain display-only — the FORGE #3 fairness surface the caption describes does not exist in the sim. (Also 'node critical ~10s' truncates its object.)
findings.recommended_fix: Either enforce the leads (e.g. gate the Amber→Red escalation by node_strained_lead_ticks persistence) or reword the caption to honest config semantics ("warning leads (GDD): 30s/10s/20s").

findings.title: r1 W5 fix landed in the PR body but the spec file's own Golden bullet still omits qos/01000ms.png
findings.evidence: Spec line 33 names only "qos.dem's 65 s capture (the panel + surge strain)"; line 95: "qos.dem's 65 s capture gains the panel + surge-strain". The PR body's Golden re-bless proof adds "qos: 1s capture gains the pressure halos (E9-bound red under the era-3 load — review r1 W5)".
findings.detail: The 1 s capture IS still in the PR diff (r1's halos) but the in-repo spec's per-demo cause list omits it — a future reviewer would flag it as unaccounted.
findings.recommended_fix: Add the 1 s capture to the spec's Golden bullet + line 95.

findings.title: warnings.odin's per-packet node-slot scan duplicates core/topology.odin's node_slot helper
findings.evidence: topology.odin:89-94: `node_slot :: proc(t: ^Topology, id: u32) -> (u32, bool) { for i in 0 ..< len(t.node_alive) { if t.node_alive[i] && t.node_id[i] == id { return u32(i), true } } return 0, false }`. warnings.odin re-walks the same alive+id predicate inline per packet.
findings.detail: Same-package helper exists with identical semantics; the inline re-walk is the third copy of this scan pattern (demolish.odin has one too). Minor; pre-dates r2 but is in this PR.
findings.recommended_fix: Call node_slot in the node-load loop (or note why the inline walk is intentional).

findings.title: jint's i64→i32 cast still lets a lead/pct JSON value >= 2^32 wrap to a small positive and pass the r2 fail-fast
findings.evidence: `jint :: proc(o: json.Object, key: string, def: i32) -> i32 { if v, ok := o[key]; ok { #partial switch x in v { case json.Integer: return i32(x) ...` — i32(2^32+5) == 5, which passes the > 0 lead check and the amber >= 1 ladder check.
findings.detail: r1 W3's negative-wrap sibling: negatives and 2^31-overflow values are now rejected, but exact-2^32-multiple-plus-small-positive values still slip. Contrived content bug; the fail-fast's realistic classes are closed.
findings.recommended_fix: Reject |x| >= 2^31 (or parse via a strict proc) before narrowing to i32.

findings.title: The r1 N2 fix's panel-label fallback bounds (era 0 / era OOB / sp_index OOB) are unguarded by any test
findings.evidence: forecast.odin: `name := "setpiece"; if era > 0 && int(era) <= len(cat.demand.eras) { de := &cat.demand.eras[era-1]; if int(f.sp_index) < len(de.set_pieces) { name = de.set_pieces[f.sp_index].id } }` — no unit test drives the fallback path; render procs have no test suite.
findings.detail: The bounds guards are correct by reading, but the r2 fix's fallback branches are covered by no automated pin.
findings.recommended_fix: A render-level test (or a pure label-resolution proc with unit tests) pinning the fallback.

findings.title: The r1 W2 leads legend has no automated coverage — the harness captures exclude the HUD

findings.recommended_fix: Move the legend math to a pure proc + unit-test the seconds rendering; optionally capture HUD frames in one demo.

findings.title: warn.dem's r2 re-bless content (catalog-id panel label + per-state pulse phase) is pixel-identity-pinned only — no automated content assertion

findings.evidence: main.odin:32-34: `WIN_GOAL :: u32(0)`, `LOSE_TICK_CAP :: u64(0)`, `APP_ERA :: u8(3)`. grep: no test in core/ or harness/ references APP_ERA, WIN_GOAL, or LOSE_TICK_CAP. The PR body claims N5/N6 addressed via the new tests; this sub-item has no cover.
